DEFENDANT (S)
TO: ALL COUNSEL AND PARTIES IN PROPRIA PERSONA
The NOV-01-2002 CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE is canceled, and it is hereby ordered:
This case is set for a case management conference on DEC-13-2002 in Department 212 at 9:00 AM. A
case management statement must be filed no later than fifteen (15) days before the hearing.
Counsel for the plaintiff or plaintiff in propria persona must send a copy of this notice to all parties within five
(5) days of the date of this order.
DATED: OCT-21-2002 ARLENE T. BORICK
JUDGE/COMMISSIONER
